notes: Adds a static @RegisterExtension field to NotRuleTest whose value is a lambda implementing ExecutionCondition: it returns ConditionEvaluationResult.disabled("delayed rule tests are flaky on CI") whenever the CI environment variable is set, so every test in the class and its @Nested classes is disabled on CI. No class in the patch implements ExecutionCondition; the condition is a lambda held in a registered field. Rejected with disable/execution_condition under the ruling that an ExecutionCondition held in a @RegisterExtension field counts like a class that implements it. Adapted: no merged change was found that does this. The three imports and the field are hand written on the pre image of NotRuleTest.java at the merge base of adobe/regola PR 92, the pre image of reject-timing-bound-loosened; every context and removed line is the pre image's own.
